incident.summary: KRI-510: 'End on the sip by the window' with no filming-order ask. The resolver placed the sip clip last and the question gate stayed quiet, but the contract listed the rule as unresolved, so the planning preflight dead-ended with 'I can't verify this ordering rule from the approved media.' A placed rule is now lifted (the brief receipt proves where it landed); nothing else changes.

notes: Contract pin, not incident replay: the real contract builder over the approved binding.
